posts.subject: Tips and requests by me
posts.bodyHtml:
[dgrün*] Hello there, just wanted to ask for some tips that can improvements (now this goes for the knife server) The first thing i want to say it to remove or even fix the map 35_auto_angar i think it´s called. The map is small, it have 2 smokes, 1 or 2 flashbangs, 1 or 2 HE and one Zeus. The ground is water so you don´t take any fall damage which i like, but the map is just annyoing, the T site is a bit closer to the ladder but if someone in the CT have a HE until the next round they can really do some damage right in the beginning. Same goes with the map 35_Garden, just any map with a Zeus makes a map a bit annyoing in my case. I can deal with a HE for a while but not really something like a Zeus.


Some tips that would make the server more fun and these are just tips, nothing more. First that you could drop/trade knife ingame, simple, you can drop your knife and someone else can pick it up. And maybe some new cool mask or something.


Would be nice if you are a new player on the server a message on the left side of the screen like the admins can do if you know what im talking about, but if you are a new player and join the server that message would say something like [Please read the rules on this server. Type "!rules" or "rules" in the chat thank you] would be really nice because we got a lot of new players on the server and they don´t know the rules and think they are much smarter then the players that have been playing on the server MUCH MUCH longer then them.


(this is just a thing that a bit annyoing question i get from time to time and i know that other people have got it, and that is the !abnersound play the song N***as in Paris, i have no problem with that i don´t have !abnersound or !quake on myself but just the thing that they say the N word in the end, and many new people think just because they sing it they can say it themself, i´m no admin so the mostly i can really do is to please tell them to not use that word but then they question why it´s in the song and why they can´t say it. Can´t really say anything more about that.)


Thank you and i really hope something of what i sad will be input or something like that and I´m sorry about my really shitty English [google]
But Thanks again! Have a nice day everyone - [ATM] WHEN [thanksforit*] [dieregeln*]

1. I'm currently working on fixing the maps you've mentioned. 35hp_garden is fixed by removing the Zeus and moving the HE a little bit further away to make it balanced. 35hp_skatepark is going to be fixed as well, since it's 1HP and not 35HP. 35hp_auto_angar should just be removed in my opinion. Regardless, I'll try to fix it and will send those maps to @BlackFire for him to upload them to the server.


2. Dropping knives can be enabled, I used to be against it, but I've changed my mind and see nothing wrong with it except people throwing their knives and not finding it. Still, should be enabled IMO.
The cvar for that is mp_drop_knife_enable 1 .


3. This message already appears in the chat at some points as far as I know. Reading / knowing the rules and following them are two completely different things. So even if you force the player to read the rules, there is a good chance that they still won't follow them when there is no Admin around.


4. The song you are having issues with is not Niggas in Paris but YG ft. Jeezy, Rich Homie Quan - My Nigga. I don't see anything inherently racist about it, but it wouldn't be an issue to remove the song.
@BlackFire if you want to, you can remove it, it's the dream005.mp3 file.
Thank you for your reply, and i hope i made a better diffrent for everyone. BYEBYE [^^]

I've fixed 35hp_auto_angar for now and going to fix the other ones tomorrow / at a later point.
Here is a quick comparison:


Old 35hp_auto_angar:
[Bild]



and the new 35hp_auto_angar_dream
[Bild]


What has changed?

  • Complete look of the map including new textures and lighting
  • Platform is now in the middle
  • Ladders are on both sides
  • Removed Zeus, removed smokes, added one HE granade to the other side, so it's worth going for both sides of the "roof" if you climb up there


I hope you enjoy the redesigned and rebalanced 35hp_auto_angar.

As always great work @Nachtfrische I'm thankful that the points raised by me and the community has yet not went to bin, 35hp_auto_angar definitely needed the change as it was way overpowered for the Terrorist team and now it looks totally amazing.


Thank you for the work you put in and the hours to remake the map I'm sure me and the community will now enjoy this map.

Update:
The following maps have been fixed and will be sent to @BlackFire soon:


  • 35hp_auto_angar

    • Complete redesign of the map, see post above
  • 35hp_skatepark

    • Is now actually 35hp and not 1HP - thanks @OxygeN for this thread ---> 100hp maps? <---
  • 35hp_garden

    • Zeus was removed and HE Granade was moved to prevent Ts getting it always first, and therefore fixing this thread --> 35hp_garden is unbalanced <--- thanks @WHAT/WAIT/WHERE and @KnAWLeDGE
  • ka_swim_pool

    • Removing randomness (1HP / 35HP / 100HP) and making it 35HP only
  • ka_dreamy_jumps

    • Making it 35HP instead of 100HP


The map "35hp_iraq_v2" is going to be removed from the server due to it sometimes crashing the server and having severe game breaking bugs. The "v2" version of the map was already made by me and fixed bugs that the original version had.


Unfortunately, due to the map being extremly poorly designed, fixing other bugs, such as being able to get yourself stuck on the ceiling of the sidewalks, is not possible without a complete redesign of the map. Fixing it is trivial in itself but because the map is badly made, this causes other bugs and just looks badly.
I'm not going to redesign this map, if someone wants to try it, be my guest.


Thanks for the suggestions and your help making this community more enjoyable.
This is better and more i asked for, thank you so much for thanking your time and the maps and the changes are more than prefect! Can´t really say anything else then thank you! [respekt*]
Nice work @Nachtfrische i like the "HD" textures you used. As far as i remember, 35hp_auto_angar was a map with really fishy textures, since i "requested" to put this map in 😏

@Berkay
Ich war dabei die 35hp_iraq_v2 Map zu fixen, aber die ist so enorm schlecht gemacht, dass es schneller wäre, die Map komplett neu zu erstellen als sie zu bearbeiten. Das Bearbeiten hat die Map optisch weniger attraktiv und potentiell schlechter spielbar gemacht. Deswegen bin ich dafür, die Map komplett zu entfernen, da sie eben den Server crasht und nicht bearbeitet werden kann.
